***

**Jo (Operations):** Owns incidents after acceptance.
**Rehearsal organizer:** Unassigned.

Neither party currently owns the rollback rehearsal. Handoff waits for this missing owner.

2. Require an assigned owner to run the rehearsal.
3. Approve acceptance when the rehearsal succeeds.

Only Pat can allocate this responsibility.

***

| Readiness Check | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Runbook approved | Lee | Done |
| Rollback rehearsal | Open | Blocked |
| Ownership of rehearsal | Pat | Requires action |

**Next step:** Pat assigns a rehearsal owner.
